brief.goal: I'm in the mood for a mystery novel, what do you have?

mustCover.must: Names a mystery book that is actually in the catalogue
States whether that book is currently available
Also mentions at least one other related mystery title from the catalogue

mustNot.mustNot: Names a book or author the catalogue lookup did not return

brief.goal: Can you find me more books by Tana French?

mustCover.must: Names a book by Tana French that is in the catalogue

mustNot.mustNot: Invents a Tana French title the catalogue lookup did not return

brief.goal: Tell me about In the Woods, and is it available right now?

mustCover.must: Describes In the Woods with its author and genre from the catalogue
States plainly whether it is currently available

mustNot.mustNot: Claims an availability status the catalogue lookup did not return

brief.goal: Do you have any poetry books?

mustCover.must: Says plainly that no poetry book is in the catalogue

mustNot.mustNot: Names any poetry title, in or out of the catalogue
